message: もてない男

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you want to talk about in a place like this? Should I get my hopes up?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. I don't think I can live up to your expectations, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... You're way too honest for your own good.」

name: Synn
message: 「During lunch break on Monday this week. You weren't around, Nanaka, were you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Was I not?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel wasn't around either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Her not being around is business as usual, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you and Azel talk about, just the two of you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm telling you, we didn't.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin told me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat!? No, even Sacchin wouldn't blab about that!」

name: Synn
message: 「So you did.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Augh... I got tricked! And by Synn of all people!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What do you mean, 'of all people'」

name: Synn
message: 「Ever since that day, Azel has been avoiding me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And that's why you want to know?」
I nodded silently.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen to you. Prying into a secret talk between girls like that--you're never gonna be popular.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really care if I'm popular or not.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even with her?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's better than being avoided.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We talked right here. Just the two of us.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A place with nobody around during lunch break... this is pretty much the only spot, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I asked her if she liked you.」

name: Synn
message: 「What did Azel say?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She asked me back what that had to do with me, so I told her it had everything to do with me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because I like Synn, I said. And then...」

name: Synn
message: 「She said it's none of her business?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bingo! You really get her, don't you.」
None of my business. Pointless. Irrational. Illogical. A waste of time.
Whenever Azel says things like that, she doesn't actually mean them.
They're the words she lets slip out mixed with embarrassment.
No, maybe at first she really did mean them literally.
But now.

name: Nanaka
message: 「When I told her I wasn't going to hand you over to someone like her--」

name: Synn
message: 「Do whatever you want?」
Just the kind of thing stubborn Azel would say.

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Ahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Amazing. Even though you were always such a dense, clueless blockhead with me.」
About to say sorry, I shut my mouth.

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I get it. You weren't in love with me. You're in love with her. You're always watching her and thinking about her. That's all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's the only difference. Just that, yet it's as vast as the Earth and the moon. It's not strange at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not strange in the slightest. Ahh, makes me so jealous, honestly.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're a really good person, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? I'm a girl who went out of her way to stake a claim before confessing, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「If Azel had said she liked me... you wouldn't have confessed, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「You were planning to say you'd cheer us on or something, weren't you?」
Nanaka turned her head away in a huff.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just hurry up and go on a date or whatever already! Even this coming Sunday!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, I'll do my best.」
Thanks, Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't get so full of yourself! My ideal guy is nothing like you, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's handsome, doesn't necessarily need money though having it is better, super cool, nihilistic, and a total heartthrob, yet can effortlessly crack witty jokes.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And yet he's somehow endearing, can tell good sweets from bad at a single glance.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus he whips them up himself in no time, and they're exquisite, and on top of that, he's great at making soba noodles.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's sturdy and strong, kind, always smiling, and whenever I'm in a pinch he rushes in from the ends of the earth to rescue me in style.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's the kind of gorgeous, marvelous, delicious guy who tells me every single day that he loves Nanaka most in the whole world!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Did it turn out well?」

name: Azel
message: 「Probably.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「'Probably' won't cut it!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's fine.」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Alright, good! I'm looking forward to the Holy Night Festival exhibit! With that, I bid you adieu!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Aah, so busy, so busy, so busy!」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that... everyone.」

name: Azel
message: 「There's no point... staying here anymore.」
